headline: Canadian protests against AI data centres nudge Reversion
body: A quiet day. Protesters gathered at the Saskatchewan legislature in Regina to call for a halt to a proposed AI data centre, part of a wider wave of Canadian protests that also reached Vancouver and Hamilton. Public pushback like this feeds Tech Backlash, which edges Reversion up very slightly. Nothing else moved, and Horizon Balance stays at +3.40.
movers_note: Reversion +0.1 from the Saskatchewan data-centre protest (+0.07); no other ending moved.
